items.title: ADP (ADP) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of payroll and HR services provider Automatic Data Processing (NASDAQ:ADP) jumped 2.3% in the afternoon session after the company’s National Employment Report data showed U.S. private-sector hiring rebounded for the first time in seven weeks. According to STL.News, citing ADP Research’s NER Pulse, private employers added an average of 9,500 jobs per week in the four weeks ending August 1, 2026 — up from 8,250 for the four weeks ending July 25.
